We have retrieved polymorphs for many compositions, saved individual JSON files. Need to consolidate into a single dataset with source_composition field. Use consolidate_polymorph_datasets tool. Provide composition_files dict mapping composition to file path. The result will be a consolidated JSON file path. Then output that path.

We have composition_files list in result. Need to extract mapping. Could manually construct dict using the provided mapping. Use tool consolidate_polymorph_datasets.
